premise: In a world where memories are currency, a grieving mother seeks vengeance against the guild that stole her son's mind, unaware she is being manipulated by an ancient entity feeding on forgotten sorrows.

characters.name: Lira Veyne
characters.trait: She can only speak in riddles, her words shaping reality but at the cost of her own sanity.

characters.name: Kael Dravon
characters.trait: He cannot die, his soul bound to the first memory he ever held—his brother’s last whisper.

characters.name: Varys Mourn
characters.trait: He hears the voices of the dead, but they always tell him what he already knows will happen.
